statement: Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r, r equals the maximum of the set of all sums sum_{t=1}^{k} nums1[i_t] * nums2[j_t], where k is an integer with 1 <= k <= min(len(nums1), len(nums2)), 0 <= i_1 < i_2 < ... < i_k < len(nums1), and 0 <= j_1 < j_2 < ... < j_k < len(nums2).
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.

statement: For every nums1 and nums2 satisfying the preconditions, the call max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r and does not fail, panic, or overflow.
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r, there exist an integer k with 1 <= k <= min(len(nums1), len(nums2)) and strictly increasing 0-based index sequences 0 <= i_1 < ... < i_k < len(nums1) and 0 <= j_1 < ... < j_k < len(nums2) such that r = sum_{t=1}^{k} nums1[i_t] * nums2[j_t].
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1) and every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), r >= nums1[i] * nums2[j].
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r, -1000000 <= r <= 500000000.
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r, r equals the maximum of the set { nums1[i] * nums2[j] | 0 <= i < len(nums1) and 0 <= j < len(nums2) }.
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000; min(len(nums1), len(nums2)) = 1.

statement: Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r, r >= sum_{i=0}^{n-1} nums1[i] * nums2[i].
preconditions: len(nums1) = len(nums2) = n for some integer n with 1 <= n <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < n, -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000 and -1000 <= nums2[i] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r and max_dot_product(nums2, nums1) returns a result s, r = s.
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.

statement: Let neg1 and neg2 be the arrays with neg1[i] = -nums1[i] and neg2[j] = -nums2[j]. Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r and max_dot_product(neg1, neg2) returns a result s, r = s.
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.

statement: Let rev1 and rev2 be the arrays with rev1[i] = nums1[len(nums1)-1-i] and rev2[j] = nums2[len(nums2)-1-j]. Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r and max_dot_product(rev1, rev2) returns a result s, r = s.
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.

statement: Let scaled1 be the array with scaled1[i] = c * nums1[i] for every i. Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r and max_dot_product(scaled1, nums2) returns a result s, s = c * r.
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000; c is a positive integer and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= c * nums1[i] <= 1000.

statement: Let M be the maximum of the set { nums1[i] * nums2[j] | 0 <= i < len(nums1) and 0 <= j < len(nums2) }. If M > 0, then whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r, r <= min(len(nums1), len(nums2)) * M.
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r and max_dot_product(nums1', nums2') returns a result s, r <= s.
preconditions: All four arrays nums1, nums2, nums1', nums2' have lengths between 1 and 500 inclusive and entries between -1000 and 1000. The array nums1 is a subsequence of nums1' (there exist strictly increasing indices p_1 < ... < p_len(nums1) in nums1' with nums1'[p_t] = nums1[t] for all t), and nums2 is a subsequence of nums2' (similarly).

statement: Let abs1 and abs2 be the arrays with abs1[i] = |nums1[i]| and abs2[j] = |nums2[j]|. Whenever max_dot_product(nums1, nums2) returns a result r and max_dot_product(abs1, abs2) returns a result s, r <= s.
preconditions: len(nums1) and len(nums2) are each between 1 and 500 inclusive; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), -1000 <= nums1[i] <= 1000; for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums2), -1000 <= nums2[j] <= 1000.
